name: fogo-mapa-operacional
description: Inventário Inteligente da Cidade (F.O.G.O.) — mapa operacional de equipamentos e agentes de segurança e trânsito.

scripts.setup: npm install && npm run db:setup -w server
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web,sim -c red,cyan,gray "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web" "npm run simulate -w server"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
